revenue.rationale: The accepted generic revenue feature represents the operating top line. RevenueFromOperations is the exact structured operating top line; Income includes OtherIncome and is rejected as the revenue denominator.
revenue.missingness_behavior: No PIT-visible operating_revenue fact means revenue is unavailable; no alternative concept is selected.

ebitda_reported.rationale: Representative current integrated filings expose no stable structured reported-EBITDA concept. Finance cost and depreciation do not authorize an EBITDA construction.

borrowings_current.rationale: BorrowingsCurrent is an explicit structured instant fact and is retained under its exact accounting meaning.
borrowings_current.missingness_behavior: An absent or nil source fact remains unavailable; only an explicit reported zero is zero.

borrowings_non_current.rationale: BorrowingsNoncurrent is an explicit structured instant fact and is retained under its exact accounting meaning.
borrowings_non_current.missingness_behavior: An absent or nil source fact remains unavailable; only an explicit reported zero is zero.

total_debt.rationale: The accepted total_debt contract does not define lease liabilities, current maturities, debt securities, preference shares, accrued interest, or other interest-bearing liabilities precisely enough for a complete non-double-counting derivation.
total_debt.missingness_behavior: Total debt remains unavailable; borrowings are never summed or reverse-engineered from DebtEquityRatio.

finance_cost.rationale: FinanceCosts is an explicit structured duration fact already accepted by the NSE financial mapping.
finance_cost.missingness_behavior: An absent or nil source fact remains unavailable.

depreciation_amortisation.rationale: DepreciationDepletionAndAmortisationExpense is an explicit structured duration fact retained without using it to construct EBITDA.
depreciation_amortisation.missingness_behavior: An absent or nil source fact remains unavailable.
